intent: Metric 4: semantic measures for the week-on-week change

edits.new_content:
version: 2
semantic_models:
- name: fct_github_daily
  description: 'Metric 4: GitHub activity per UTC day (PRs opened, PRs merged, commits), one row per day
    per activity. Never add counts across activities.'
  model: ref('fct_github_daily')
  defaults:
    agg_time_dimension: activity_date
  entities:
  - name: github_day
    type: primary
    expr: github_day_key
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  dimensions:
  - name: activity_date
    type: time
    description: UTC day.
    type_params:
      time_granularity: day
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  - name: activity
    type: categorical
    description: prs_opened, prs_merged or commits.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  - name: activity_label
    type: categorical
    description: PRs opened, PRs merged or Commits.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  - name: weekday_name
    type: categorical
    description: Day of the week.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  - name: is_release_day
    type: categorical
    description: True on GTA 6's release day.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  - name: days_from_release
    type: categorical
    description: Days after release day (negative before).
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  measures:
  - name: github_activity_count_measure
    agg: sum
    expr: activity_count
    description: How many on the day (GitHub Search API total_count).
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: count
          additivity: additive
          null_rule: NULL when unavailable, never zero.
  - name: github_activity_wow_pct_change
    agg: max
    expr: wow_pct_change
    description: The day against the same weekday a week earlier, in percent.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: percent
          additivity: non_additive
          null_rule: NULL unless both days have a count.
  - name: github_activity_prior_week_count
    agg: max
    expr: prior_week_count
    description: The same weekday a week earlier.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: count
          additivity: non_additive
          null_rule: NULL when that day has no count.
